data.post: The basic idea of the game was to shoot down robots and other attackers while collecting items. The setting of the first level, "Downtown," was an American city at night, with house facades in the background, some featuring neon signs. The player moved from left to right but could also climb ladders to reach higher levels. The game was thus 2D, somewhat like a Run and Jump, but with the ability to run and shoot in all directions. In addition to robots, there were also rockets and tractors as enemies. You could also die from a broken gas pipe in the ground that occasionally spat fire. There were also oil barrels that you could shoot to receive an ice cream or a hamburger, which granted extra points. Unfortunately, I no longer remember what the exact objective of the level was. You could run and shoot in all four directions: left, right, up, and down. Additionally, you could jump and collect the items obtained from shooting the barrels.
